item.text:
Refactored the matcher into a more explicit API with immutable request/result objects and a thinner CLI.

What changed:
- Added [KmpSearchRequest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpSearchRequest.java) to make the `pattern`/`text` input pair a first-class value object.
- Added [KmpSearchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpSearchResult.java) to carry the request and the matches together with value semantics.
- Updated [KmpMatcher.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpMatcher.java) so the core API now supports `search(request)` while keeping the convenience `findAllMatches(pattern, text)` method.
- Updated [KMPSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KMPSearch.java) to parse either the built-in sample or two CLI arguments.
- Tightened [KmpFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpFormatter.java) so formatting works on the richer result type.
- Updated [KmpExamples.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpExamples.java) and [KmpMatcherTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/kmp/KmpMatcherTest.java) to use the shared request fixture and exercise the new API.

Design improvements:
- Search inputs are now explicit and immutable.
- The matcher returns a domain result instead of only a raw list.
- The public convenience API still exists for simple callers.
- The CLI can now search arbitrary input instead of only the hard-coded sample.

Verification:
- `javac kmp/*.java` succeeded.
- `java -cp . kmp.KMPSearch` printed `0 9 12`.
- `java -cp . kmp.KmpMatcherTest` printed `All KMP matcher tests passed.`

I also removed generated `.class` files after verification so the workspace is source-only again.
